85277.synopsis:
The year was 4163 in Earth History. The extensive history of humanity, under the banner of the Earth Empire, was coming to an end.
Leading the Earth Empire’s 109th Patrol Fleet was 79-year-old Rear Admiral Liliane Luzoule. Though having attained her current position through seniority, she once held high promises as the only daughter of the former chief of staff. However, due to a single fatal mistake sixty years ago, she had lost her first love, her friends, her family, and any trust people had for her. Now, a declining patrol fleet is all she leads.
Under the looming shadow of the Horsehead Nebula, a major offensive fleet from an enemy that has been at war with the Earth Empire for over sixty years, was fast approaching. Against an overwhelming threat, Liliane’s fleet was sent as a sacrificial pawn and was unceremoniously annihilated. Under the glow of heavy particle beams, Liliane departed from this world… is how it was supposed to go. However, when she regain consciousness, she had been sent back to her 18-year-old self, who was about to graduate.
Reflecting over how her over-assertiveness had caused everything in her first life, the mentally 79-year-old Liliane decided to take a backseat and let the talented people around her take the wheel. There was a girl she used to mistreat but had tremendous talent as a strategist, so she worked hard so that the girl could demonstrate that talent, regardless of her standing. Before she knew it, the girl attained a high position and was in command of a battleship…!
Furthermore, she had caught the attention of the commander of the moon base! Not to mention, despite being nothing but a figurehead in Liliane’s past life, the commander was a very capable person! To top it all off, that genius strategist had began to adore her, and the admirals that she butted heads against in her past life, began putting their faith in her!
“I stepped off the spotlight, so why is this happening! More importantly, isn’t a war about to break out!?”

Yu Su, as a merman in the new century, always remembers his father’s admonition never to go ashore. He obediently plays the role of a “vase” at the bottom of the sea, occasionally helping with the reproduction issues of other species.

I was reincarnated into the world of a gal game called Love or Dead (LoD).
In LoD, the heroines face two extreme outcomes: either they find love and happiness, or they die tragically. If a heroine isn’t chosen, her story ends in despair—it’s a ruthless game with no middle ground.
As a mere mob character, I thought I could stay uninvolved, but fate had other plans. Somehow, I became entangled in their tragic destinies. To save the heroines—and myself—I had only one option: achieve the elusive harem ending.
Determined to help the protagonist fulfill this happy ending, I worked tirelessly behind the scenes. But no matter how much I tried, my choices always led to disaster. Again and again, I caused the worst possible outcome: a bad ending where no one found love, and everyone suffered.
Consumed by guilt and hopelessness, I resolved to change the script—no matter the cost. When one of the heroines, Satsuki, was about to be hit by a car, I didn’t hesitate. I pushed her out of harm’s way, ready to sacrifice everything. And then…

99101.synopsis:
1.
After being tricked into going on a blind date, Shu Yao bumped into her high school classmate Chen Ye, whom she hasn’t seen in seven years, on the subway. 
Once, her best friend and his buddy were sweetly in love, and the two of them could only sit awkwardly and look at each other in silence. 
And now, something even more embarrassing happened— 
They are wearing the same outfit. 
Fortunately, Chen Ye didn’t seem to remember her. 
Shu Yao secretly felt happy and was about to grab her bag and run away when someone suddenly passed by. 
That person hesitated, stopped, looked them up and down, and suddenly exclaimed with wide eyes: 
“You two are still together?! Wearing couple outfit is quite romantic! I believe in love again!” 
Shu Yao: “…?” 
2. 
Faced with various blind dates, between asking for help and pleading for mercy, Shu Yao chose to propose. 
“I have no expectations for marriage. Since the photo of us wearing matching clothes has turned into a couple’s photo, and you also need this, how about we cooperate?” 
Chen Ye leaned against the table leisurely and asked her: “What do you like about me?” 
Shu Yao made up something, but remained calm: “Your occasionally unpredictable state of mind is quite charming.” 
“……” 
Chen Ye agreed. 
The reason was he appreciated those who can insult others elegantly. 
3. 
After marriage, the two respected each other like guests. 
So Shu Yao always thought he began liking her after they were married. 
Until a long time later, at a gathering, during a game of truth or dare, Chen Ye’s friend was asked about the most speechless moment in his life. 
Without hesitation, he pointed at Chen Ye: “About a year ago, in the middle of the night, he sent me 10 voice messages bragging that he was getting married.” 
Other friends gasped and quickly pulled out their phones to ask: “How many people did you send this to?” 
“Not many.” Chen Ye leaned back lazily, somewhat regretfully adding, “Too bad my dog doesn’t have a phone.” 
Shu Yao: “……” 
How would a dog use a phone? 
Shu Yao glanced at the man beside her. 
Oh no, it seems possible.

Madam Zhao from next door gritted her teeth and spent ten taels of silver to take her in, making her a concubine for her grandson, Zhao Yanping.

Crunch!

“Lady! You’re alive!”
The sweet scent of the woman who embraced me as if relieved kept making my mouth fall open.
At this moment, I could just bite her down in one go…
These were the very people who had abandoned me and fled.
So taking a bite out of at least one of them should be fine, right?
As the faintly sweet scent tickled my nose, my mind grew hazy.
But the grand duke, who warily pointed his sword at me, snapped me back to reality, forcing me to suppress my instincts.
